customManagers.description: Versions marked with a `# renovate: datasource=... depName=...` comment above `name=vX.Y.Z` (a run step) or `NAME: vX.Y.Z` (an env): ghalint, actionlint and pinact in ci.yml, pinact in update-readme-pins.yml, and the release of rivus that the tests install (RIVUS_VERSION in ci.yml)
